title: ChatGPT and Vaccine Hesitancy: A Comparison of English, Spanish, and French Responses Using a Validated Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Vaccine Hesitancy Scale (VHS) to the language model via prompts translated into English, Spanish, and French, and statistically comparing the resulting mean hesitancy scores across the different languages using ANOVA and t-tests to identify linguistic disparities.
